WITH phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) as phase_count
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.lunarstage
),
mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as overall_mean
  FROM phase_stats
),
filtered_phases AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.avg_bandwidth,
    ps.phase_count,
    mc.overall_mean
  FROM phase_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc
  WHERE ps.avg_bandwidth > mc.overall_mean
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_phase_avgs,
  SUM(phase_count) as total_count,
  AVG(avg_bandwidth - overall_mean) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_phases
